ice.text: Freyalise becomes a planeswalker through a duel to the death that Miko decrees after an explosion kills sixteen in Clan Emerald's quarters, under the influence of Tevesh Szat. Jason Carthalion fatally wounds her, and she forgives him and hopes to ascend, which she does, converting to green.

Freyalise then helps the elves survive the Ice Age, and they deify her, while the druids Kolbjorn and Kaysa chant her song to strip undead villagers of life. At the Summit of the Null Moon, Szat's Soul Burn gravely injures her, and she fights him on Azoria and is blinded.
Freyalise finally casts the World Spell, with the help of Taysir and Kristina, in 2934 AR to break the Shard and end the Ice Age, which begins the Thaw and causes flooding and climate change.

all.text: Freyalise is called on when Jaya Ballard rescues Jodah, who was drugged by Lim-Dul, and summons her, promising the school's resources for her World Spell. Jodah's mirror is used in the World Spell, and he disperses the effect through the safe havens, destroying them.
Freyalise casts her World Spell, ending the Ice Age and forcing a cold-adapted population to adjust to warm weather.

pls.text: Freyalise shows Eladamri that his Skyshroud home has followed him to Dominaria. Skyshroud arrives on the frozen wastes of Keld, where she casts a spell to keep it warm, but she relocates the forest and creates its rift, and in the end she gives her life to seal the Skyshroud rift and the forest dies with her.

tsp.text: Freyalise places Skyshroud Forest by brute force, causing the Skyshroud rift to drain green and red mana from Skyshroud and Keld. When Teferi returns and seeks her help over the time rifts, she refuses to listen, angry over his abandonment of Dominaria during the Invasion.

Freyalise takes control of the local slivers, a title the Weaver King usurps, and the slivers overrun the forest. She sacrifices herself and Skyshroud to seal the time rift, and the sacrifice heals Keld's rift.
